protocol.arm_order: within a workload, ARMS rotated by (cycle + workload index) mod 3; workloads in the fixed order 8x128, 8x512, 1x512, 32x64
protocol.boundary: caller-observed: from the call that submits the request (before tokenisation) until its answers are in the calling thread; the same for laya-fast (system_one call to return)
protocol.window_statistic: P50 of the window's measured requests

policy.name: makespan split
policy.applies_to: requests with 2 or more questions, Laya(device="auto", execution="workers"); 1-question requests are never touched
policy.eligible_row: some loaded ANE bucket fits it (length <= bucket, options <= 32)
policy.ane_rows: the k longest eligible rows, run one after another at B=1 as one ANE job
policy.gpu_rows: the rest, as one MLX batch job
policy.choice_of_k: argmin over k = 0..eligible of max(ane_backlog + sum ane_ms(bucket), gpu_backlog + gpu_ms(longest GPU row, GPU rows)); a side with no rows costs 0; ties go to the smaller k
policy.service_model: laya_apple.scheduling.ServiceModel of the instance (the shipped routing.json forward P50s on this profile); backlogs read once from the product's device queues
policy.buckets_loaded: the model's auto buckets plus the bucket each workload's longest row needs (64, 128, 512); the auto tie band pinned to laya-apple 1.5.0's
policy.fallback: none: a device error fails the request
